rules: No outcome percentages without definitions, denominators, follow-up windows, and conflict labels.
Every clinic record is claim tracking, not endorsement.

starterRecords.name: Clinic claim monitoring
starterRecords.summary: Clinic entries track public claims, locations, safety statements, outcome language, and adverse-event signals. IbogaBase does not rank clinics or provide referrals.

starterRecords.name: Ambio Life Sciences
starterRecords.location: Mexico and Malta, based on public company claims
starterRecords.staffingClaims: Company site names clinical and leadership staff; peer-reviewed papers list Ambio-affiliated authors.
starterRecords.safetyClaims: Nature Medicine paper and company materials describe screening, ECG, medication review, monitoring, and magnesium coadministration in specific research/treatment contexts.
starterRecords.outcomeClaims: Published observational and case-report literature involving Ambio-affiliated authors reports short-term outcomes; controlled efficacy trials remain needed.
starterRecords.adverseEventSignals: Track alongside published safety statements, conflict disclosures, and broader ibogaine cardiac-risk literature.
starterRecords.regulatoryNotes: Ibogaine remains Schedule I in the United States and is not FDA-approved as a treatment.
starterRecords.summary: Ambio is included as a clinic/company/research-site claim record because it appears in peer-reviewed research and public reporting. This is not a referral, ranking, endorsement, or provider recommendation.
